validated_targets.experimental_detail: CDK4/6 inhibitor abemaciclib showed selective sensitivity in cancer cell lines, confirming CDK4 as a druggable vulnerability.
CDK4/6 inhibitor abemaciclib showed selective sensitivity in cancer cell lines, confirming CDK6 as a druggable vulnerability.

title: Genomic Aberrations that Activate D-type Cyclins Are Associated with Enhanced Sensitivity to the CDK4 and CDK6 Inhibitor Abemaciclib.

evidence_summary: Transfection of human recoverin cDNA into lung adenocarcinoma A549 cells significantly reduced cell proliferation, validating functional role in cancer cell growth.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Overexpression of recoverin by transfection in A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells led to significant reduction in cell proliferation.

title: Aberrant expression of photoreceptor-specific calcium-binding protein (recoverin) in cancer cell lines.

evidence_summary: Isogenic MMR-deficient and proficient colorectal and endometrial cancer cell lines treated with 6-thioguanine revealed MMR-dependent autophagy induction; p53 inhibition blocked autophagy signaling, and ATG5 knockdown abrogated autophagy, increasing apoptosis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: MLH1-null HCT116 cells failed to induce autophagy after 6-TG treatment, while MLH1-proficient cells did, as measured by LC3 marker.
MSH2-null HEC59 cells lacked 6-TG-induced autophagy, whereas MSH2-proficient cells exhibited autophagy, linking MSH2 to the process.
Chemical inhibition of p53 with pifithrin-alpha or p53 shRNA prevented autophagy signaling triggered by MMR processing of 6-TG.
ATG5 shRNA blocked autophagy and resulted in increased apoptosis after MMR processing of 6-TG, demonstrating that autophagy inhibits apoptosis.

title: DNA mismatch repair initiates 6-thioguanine--induced autophagy through p53 activation in human tumor cells.

evidence_summary: Retroviral-mediated expression of SV40 large T antigen or adenovirus E1A immortalized primary rat endometrial cells; subsequent superinfection with v-Ha-ras and soft agar selection generated fully transformed cells, validating their oncogenic capacity in this context.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Retroviral transduction of SV40 large T antigen immortalized primary rat endometrial cells, giving rise to the RENT4 cell line.
Retroviral transduction of adenovirus E1A immortalized primary rat endometrial cells, generating RENE1 and RENE2 cell lines.
Superinfection of SV40 large T-immortalized cells with v-Ha-ras retrovirus and soft agar selection produced fully transformed RENTR01 and RENTR03 lines.

title: Establishment of rat endometrial cell lines by retroviral mediated transfer of immortalizing and transforming oncogenes.

evidence_summary: Adenoviral overexpression of progesterone receptor isoforms A and B in Hec50co endometrial cancer cells inhibited proliferation via p21/p27 induction, reduced Matrigel invasion, and downregulated adhesion molecules (FN1, ITGA3, ITGB1, ITGB3, CDH6) confirmed by RT-PCR, with PRB showing greater effect.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Adenoviral overexpression of PRB in Hec50co cells inhibited proliferation, invasion, and induced secretory phenotype; loss of PRB is linked to poorly differentiated endometrial tumors.
Progesterone induced p21 (CDKN1A) expression, contributing to reduced percentage of proliferating Hec50co cells.
Progesterone induced p27 (CDKN1B) expression, contributing to reduced percentage of proliferating Hec50co cells.
PRB overexpression significantly downregulated FN1 mRNA levels in Hec50co cells as confirmed by RT-PCR.
PRB overexpression significantly downregulated ITGA3 mRNA levels in Hec50co cells as confirmed by RT-PCR.
PRB overexpression significantly downregulated ITGB1 mRNA levels in Hec50co cells as confirmed by RT-PCR.
PRB overexpression significantly downregulated ITGB3 mRNA levels in Hec50co cells as confirmed by RT-PCR.
PRB overexpression significantly downregulated CDH6 mRNA levels in Hec50co cells as confirmed by RT-PCR.

title: Progesterone inhibits human endometrial cancer cell growth and invasiveness: down-regulation of cellular adhesion molecules through progesterone B receptors.

evidence_summary: HO-3867 and Metformin treatment inhibited EV secretion and decreased oncogenic proteins TMEM205, STAT5, FAS in vitro and in HFD mice, suppressing EC cell proliferation and hyperplasia; adipocyte-derived EVs increased EC cell proliferation, migration, and xenograft tumor growth, validating TMEM205, STAT5, FAS as oncogenes and PIAS3 as tumor suppressor.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Adipocyte-derived EVs carrying TMEM205 increased EC cell proliferation, migration, and xenograft tumor growth; HO-3867 or Metformin decreased its expression.
STAT5 carried by adipocyte-derived EVs promoted EC cell proliferation, migration, and xenograft tumor growth; drug treatment reduced its expression.
FAS as oncogenic cargo in EVs enhanced EC cell proliferation, migration, and xenograft tumor growth; inhibitors lowered its levels.
PIAS3 was downregulated in obesity-mediated EC; HO-3867 or Metformin treatment inhibited hyperplasia, consistent with restoration of tumor suppressor function.

title: Obesity-induced extracellular vesicles proteins drive the endometrial cancer pathogenesis: therapeutic potential of HO-3867 and Metformin.

evidence_summary: Active β-catenin induced transcriptional activation of p16INK4A and p21WAF1 promoters in endometrial carcinoma cell lines; serum starvation experiments showed altered pRb and p16INK4A expression.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Active form β-catenin transcriptionally activated p16INK4A and p21WAF1 promoters via the -385 to -280 bp region in a TCF4-independent manner.
p16INK4A promoter was directly activated by active β-catenin, and its expression was induced during trans-differentiation and serum starvation-induced growth arrest.
p21WAF1 promoter was activated by active β-catenin in a TCF4-independent manner similar to p16INK4A, and nuclear accumulation persisted in morules.

title: Induction of p16INK4A mediated by beta-catenin in a TCF4-independent manner: implications for alterations in p16INK4A and pRb expression during trans-differentiation of endometrial carcinoma cells.

evidence_summary: Pharmacological inhibition of CDK2 with BLU-222 and combination with CDK4/6 inhibitor in CCNE1-aberrant ovarian and endometrial cancer cell lines and xenografts demonstrated antitumor activity, validating CDK2 and CDK4/6 as therapeutic targets with Rb/p16 status predicting sensitivity.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Selective CDK2 inhibitor BLU-222 showed robust antitumor activity in CCNE1-high ovarian and endometrial cancer models; sensitivity was enriched by Rb expression and low p16.
Combination of BLU-222 with a CDK4/6 inhibitor enhanced response in CCNE1-aberrant models with intact Rb and low p16 expression.

title: Profiling the Activity of the Potent and Highly Selective CDK2 Inhibitor BLU-222 Reveals Determinants of Response in CCNE1-Aberrant Ovarian and Endometrial Tumors.

evidence_summary: Clofarabine (RNR inhibitor) treatment showed sensitivity in Aα mutant uterine serous tumor models in vivo, and PP2A catalytic inhibitor LB-100 sensitized wild-type USC cells to RNRi, confirming synthetic lethality.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Clofarabine (RNR inhibitor) showed synthetic lethality in Aα-mutant (PPP2R1A mutant) uterine serous carcinoma cell lines and in vivo tumors, with impaired checkpoint signaling and increased DNA damage.
LB-100, a catalytic inhibitor of PP2A, sensitized wild-type uterine serous carcinoma cells to ribonucleotide reductase inhibitor, phenocopying PP2A-deficient synthetic lethality.

title: Targeting Ribonucleotide Reductase Induces Synthetic Lethality in PP2A-Deficient Uterine Serous Carcinoma.
